method.rank: saved OOS predicted_score, recomputed with the canonical rank_metrics function
method.anchor: mean race winner log(P_model/q_market); daily race-date block bootstrap
method.betting_selection_order: global validation-locked test selection first, venue partition second
method.upset_selection_order: stored whole-test fraction membership first, venue partition second
method.roi: mean of official-final-dividend unit returns over available selections
method.commission: KRA final dividends already reflect takeout; the 20% win and 27% multi-bet takeout rates are not deducted a second time
method.flat_mdd: 1% of current bankroll per bet, chronological compounded equity
method.sharpe: mean per-bet return divided by sample standard deviation, multiplied by sqrt(bets)
method.kelly: quarter Kelly, capped at 2% bankroll; only direct win/place selection odds
